about: What SAM 3.1 is asked to follow in each control scene: the scene's own obstacle, by the colour its fragment gives it (see __init__.py), and whether it is a thing to touch or a hazard to fall into. Each name was checked on the example's control shots (Nov 1): found in every frame. The robot is the same in every scene. The box is the demo incident's own scene: in the control only when another scene's incident is being fixed (tools/ablation.py --scene).
